list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Integrate DomandeInsegnanteScreen into HomeTeacherScreen
This commit updates the `HomeTeacherScreen` to navigate to the `DomandeInsegnanteScreen` when the "Domande" grid tile is tapped.
The `_selectedIndex` is now used to manage the active state in the `TeacherBottomNavigationBar`.

task.summary: Default task

Add assets for Roman history
This commit adds the following assets: - colosseum.png - forum.png - trophy.png - caesar.png - rivoluzione.png - costantino.jpg - appia.jpg - lupo.jpg - venere.jpg - gladiator.jpg - lingua.png - tevere.jpg - augusto.jpg
These assets will be used to enhance the user experience and provide visual context for the Roman history content.

Add Roman Empire and French Revolution quiz data
This commit introduces two new lists of `QuizQuestion` objects: - `romanEmpireQuestions`: Contains questions related to the Roman Empire. - `frenchRevolutionQuestions`: Contains questions related to the French Revolution.
Each question includes the question text, a list of possible answers, the index of the correct answer, and an optional image path.

Create QuizIntroScreen
This commit introduces the `QuizIntroScreen` widget, which serves as an introductory screen before starting a quiz.
Key features: - Displays the quiz title, description, and an associated image dynamically. - Provides an "Inizia il Quiz!" button to navigate to the `QuizScreen`. - Implements an exit confirmation dialog when the back button is pressed. - Includes a bottom navigation bar with "Home", "Conversazioni", and "Impostazioni" items. - "Home" navigates back to the `QuizSelectionScreen`. - "Conversazioni" and "Impostazioni" are placeholders for future functionality. - The design aims for a clean and user-friendly interface.

Create quiz models
This commit introduces two new classes: `QuizQuestion` and `QuizResult`.
The `QuizQuestion` class represents a single quiz question and includes: - The question text (`question`) - A list of possible answers (`answers`) - The index of the correct answer (`correctAnswerIndex`) - An optional image path (`imagePath`)
The `QuizResult` class stores the results of a quiz and includes: - The number of correct answers (`correctAnswers`) - The number of incorrect answers (`incorrectAnswers`) - The total number of questions (`totalQuestions`) - A list of the user's answers (`userAnswers`) - A list of the correct answer indices (`correctAnswerIndices`)

Create quiz results screen
This commit introduces a new `QuizResultsScreen` widget that displays the results of a completed quiz.
The screen shows: - A "Quiz completato!" message. - Motivational text. - Statistics for correct and incorrect answers. - A trophy image. - A button to return to the quiz selection screen. - A bottom navigation bar with "Home", "Conversazioni", and "Impostazioni" options.
The `onQuizCompleted` callback is triggered when the user navigates back to the quiz selection screen.

Create quiz_runner.dart
This commit creates the `quiz_runner.dart` file.
This file defines the main application widget `QuizApp`, which sets up the MaterialApp with a title, theme, initial route, and routes. It also imports the `QuizSelectionScreen` and sets it as the initial route.

Create QuizScreen with enhanced UI and feedback
This commit introduces the `QuizScreen` widget, which handles the quiz-taking experience.
Key features include: - Display of questions with optional images. - Multiple-choice answers with visual feedback for selected, correct, and incorrect options. - Progress bar and question counter. - "Controlla" (Check) button to verify the answer and "Avanti" (Next) button to proceed. - Exit confirmation dialog. - Navigation to `QuizResultsScreen` upon quiz completion. - Callback functions `onQuizCompleted` and `onQuizExited` to notify parent widgets.
The UI has been styled with rounded corners, shadows, and color-coded feedback for a more engaging user experience.

Create QuizSelectionScreen
This commit introduces a new screen, `QuizSelectionScreen`, which allows users to select a historical period for a quiz.
The screen displays a list of available quizzes as cards, each with a title and an image. Tapping on a card navigates to the `QuizIntroScreen` for the selected quiz.
The screen also includes a bottom navigation bar for navigating between Home, Conversations, and Settings (currently implemented with placeholder SnackBars for Conversations and Settings).
Key features: - Displays a list of quiz options. - Navigates to the `QuizIntroScreen` upon selection. - Includes a bottom navigation bar. - Implements a method to return to the quiz selection screen after quiz completion or exit.

Create QuizWidget
This commit introduces the `QuizWidget` class, which serves as an entry point for the quiz functionality.
The `QuizWidget`: - Takes optional `onQuizCompleted` and `onQuizExited` callbacks to notify the parent application about the quiz flow's state. - Directly displays the `QuizIntroScreen`. - Passes the quiz data (`romanEmpireQuestions`) and the callbacks to the `QuizIntroScreen`.
Navigation within the quiz (Intro -> Quiz -> Results) is managed by pushing `MaterialPageRoute` instances.

Add new assets and IDEA project files
This commit introduces several new image assets: - appia.jpg - augusto.jpg - costantino.jpg - gladiator.jpg - lingua.png - lupo.jpg - tevere.jpg - venere.jpg
Additionally, this commit adds IntelliJ IDEA project configuration files: - .idea/.gitignore - .idea/libraries/Dart_Packages.xml - .idea/libraries/Dart_SDK.xml - .idea/caches/deviceStreaming.xml - .idea/Gruppo-1-IUM-2024-2025.iml - .idea/misc.xml - .idea/modules.xml - .idea/vcs.xml

Implement DomandaModel
This commit introduces the `DomandaModel` class, which represents a question in the application.
The `DomandaModel` includes the following properties: - `testo`: The text of the question. - `data`: The date the question was created. - `stato`: The status of the question (nuova, incompleta, completa), managed by the `StatoDomanda` enum. - `personaggio`: The character or topic associated with the chat. - `immagineAsset`: The path to the asset image for the character/topic.
The class also provides methods to: - Change the question's status. - Mark a question as opened or completed. - Get a label for the current status. - Create a copy of the model with updated values using `copyWith`.

Create domande_runner.dart
This commit introduces a new Dart file, `domande_runner.dart`, which defines a simple Flutter application.
The `DomandeApp` widget serves as the root of the application and displays the `SchermataDomande` widget as its home screen.
The application has the following characteristics: - Debug banner is hidden. - Title is set to 'Runner Domande'. - Primary theme color is set to `Colors.indigo`.

Create SchermataDomande
This commit introduces the `SchermataDomande` widget, which displays a list of questions related to historical topics.
Key features of this screen include: - A list of `DomandaModel` objects, each representing a question with its text, date, status, associated character/topic, and image. - A responsive card layout for each question, displaying its details and a play button to navigate to the conversation screen. - A bottom navigation bar for navigating to different sections of the app (Home, Conversazioni, Impostazioni). - Status chips that visually indicate whether a question is new, incomplete, or completed. - Navigation to `SchermataConversazione` when a question card is tapped, passing the selected question and a callback to update its status.

Create SchermataDomande
This commit introduces the `SchermataDomande` widget, which displays a list of questions related to historical topics.
Key features of this screen include: - A list of `DomandaModel` objects, each representing a question with its text, date, status, associated character/topic, and image. - A responsive card layout for each question, displaying its details and a play button to navigate to the conversation screen. - A bottom navigation bar for navigating to different sections of the app (Home, Conversazioni, Impostazioni). - Status chips that visually indicate whether a question is new, incomplete, or completed. - Navigation to `SchermataConversazione` when a question card is tapped, passing the selected question and a callback to update its status.

Add Git mapping for Flutter SDK
This commit updates the VCS configuration to include a mapping for the Flutter SDK directory. Additionally, it introduces new screens and modifies existing ones:
- **New Screens:** - `AggiungiClasseScreen`: Likely for adding new classes. - `ClassiScreen`: Likely for displaying existing classes. - `ConversazioniScreen`: Likely for managing conversations.
- **Modified Screen:** - `HomeTeacherScreen`: Updated, potentially to integrate with the new class and conversation screens.
The Gradle module files have also been updated, likely due to dependency changes or project structure adjustments.

Update Kotlin plugin paths in Gradle module files
Replaced hardcoded paths to Kotlin compiler plugins (`assignment-compiler-plugin.jar` and `sam-with-receiver-compiler-plugin.jar`) with the `C:/Users/sicka/AppData/Local/Google/AndroidStudio2024.3.2/kotlin-dist-for-ide/2.0.21` variable in `gradle.main.iml` and `gradle.test.iml`. This makes the paths more portable and less dependent on the user's specific Android Studio installation directory.

Create AggiungiClasseScreen
This commit introduces the `AggiungiClasseScreen` widget, which allows users to add a new class by providing its name and academic year.
Key features of this screen include: - A form with two `TextFormField` widgets for entering the class name and academic year. - Validation for both fields to ensure they are not empty and that the year is a number. - A "Aggiungi" (Add) button that saves the new class information and navigates back to the previous screen. - Styling consistent with the application's theme, using `AppColors.background` and specific font styles.

Create AggiungiClasseScreen
This commit introduces the `AggiungiClasseScreen` widget, which allows users to add a new class by providing its name and academic year.
Key features of this screen include: - A form with two `TextFormField` widgets for entering the class name and academic year. - Validation for both fields to ensure they are not empty and that the year is a number. - A "Aggiungi" (Add) button that saves the new class information and navigates back to the previous screen. - Styling consistent with the application's theme, using `AppColors.background` and specific font styles.

Create ConversazioniScreen
This commit introduces the `ConversazioniScreen` widget, which displays a grid of classes and allows users to select a class to start a conversation.
Key features of this screen include: - Loads a list of classes from `SharedPreferences`. If no saved classes are found, it loads a default list and saves it for future use. - Displays classes in a `GridView` with 3 columns. - Each class is represented by a card showing its name and year. - Tapping on a class card currently shows a `SnackBar` indicating the selection (TODO: implement navigation to a chat screen). - Includes an app bar with a title "Conversazioni" and a back button. - Provides a bottom navigation bar with "Home", "Conversazioni", and "Impostazioni" options. "Conversazioni" is the active tab.
The screen loads class data from `SharedPreferences` upon initialization. If no data is found, it populates the list with default class values and saves them.

Enable navigation to ConversazioniScreen and ClassiScreen
This commit updates the `HomeTeacherScreen` to allow navigation to `ConversazioniScreen` and `ClassiScreen` when the respective grid tiles are tapped.
Specifically: - Tapping the "Conversazioni" tile now navigates to `ConversazioniScreen`. - Tapping the "Classi" tile now navigates to `ClassiScreen`. - A TODO comment has been added for implementing navigation for the "Domande" tile.

Add Android Gradle module files for app and shared_preferences_android
This commit introduces the necessary `.iml` files for IntelliJ/Android Studio to correctly recognize and build the Android modules:
- **app module:** - `android.app.iml`: Main module definition. - `android.app.main.iml`: Configuration for the main source set. - `android.app.androidTest.iml`: Configuration for Android tests. - `android.app.unitTest.iml`: Configuration for unit tests. - **shared_preferences_android module:** - `android.shared_preferences_android.androidTest.iml`: Configuration for Android tests (note: this seems to be the only `.iml` file added for this plugin module in this commit, implying others might exist or are not relevant to the current changes).
These files define aspects like source paths, dependencies, Kotlin compiler settings, and Android facet configurations, enabling the IDE to manage the project structure and build processes.

Add Android Gradle module files for shared_preferences_android
This commit introduces the necessary `.iml` files for IntelliJ/Android Studio to correctly recognize and build the `shared_preferences_android` module:
- `android.shared_preferences_android.iml`: Main module definition. - `android.shared_preferences_android.main.iml`: Configuration for the main source set. - `android.shared_preferences_android.unitTest.iml`: Configuration for unit tests.
These files define aspects like source paths, dependencies, Kotlin compiler settings, and Android facet configurations, enabling the IDE to manage the project structure and build processes.
Additionally, a device configuration for "Galaxy A51" was removed from `deviceStreaming.xml`.

Update "Seleziona una classe" text
The text displayed when no class is selected in `ConversazioniScreen` has been shortened from "Seleziona una classe per avviare una conversazione" to "Seleziona una classe".

Create DomandeInsegnanteScreen
This commit introduces the `DomandeInsegnanteScreen` widget, which allows teachers to select a class to view or assign questions.
Key features: - Displays a grid of available classes. - Loads class data from `SharedPreferences` or uses a default list if no data is found. - Saves class data to `SharedPreferences` upon initial load of default classes. - Each class is represented by a card showing its name and year. - Tapping on a class card displays a temporary snackbar (navigation to be implemented). - Includes a bottom navigation bar for navigating to Home, Conversazioni, and Impostazioni.

Integrate DomandeInsegnanteScreen into HomeTeacherScreen
This commit updates the `HomeTeacherScreen` to navigate to the `DomandeInsegnanteScreen` when the "Domande" grid tile is tapped.
The `_selectedIndex` is now used to manage the active state in the `TeacherBottomNavigationBar`.
